notes: Deterministic materiality/classification thresholds consumed by tools/generate_governance_narrative.py's score_reliability(), assign_tier(), build_client_summary(), build_bc_summary(), and _low_coherence_clients(). Values here reproduce the generator's own pre-externalization Python literals exactly (see docs/governance_evidence_package.md) -- this profile does not change any classification output by itself. These are narrative/classification thresholds, not governance policy approvals. bc_alignment_high/_moderate and bc_confidence_low/moderate_max_files are a separate profile from the client_alignment_*/client_confidence_* thresholds even though their default values currently coincide -- see BC_ALIGNMENT_HIGH's definition comment in generate_governance_narrative.py.
